jobs.name: Sale
jobs.summary: Looks up five dimension keys for each staged sale line, then replaces those invoices in Fact.Sale and closes the load in the lineage log.

CREATE PROCEDURE Integration.MigrateStagedSaleData
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRAN;

    DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'Sale'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    -- Find the dimension keys required

    UPDATE s
        SET s.[City Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[City Key]
                                     FROM Dimension.City AS c
                                     WHERE c.[WWI City ID] = s.[WWI City ID]
                                     AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                     AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									 ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                           WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = s.[WWI Customer ID]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Bill To Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                                 FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                                 WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = s.[WWI Bill To Customer ID]
                                                 AND s.[Last Modified When] > c.[Valid From]
                                                 AND s.[Last Modified When] <= c.[Valid To]
									             ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Stock Item Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) si.[Stock Item Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.[Stock Item] AS si
                                           WHERE si.[WWI Stock Item ID] = s.[WWI Stock Item ID]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] > si.[Valid From]
                                           AND s.[Last Modified When] <= si.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY si.[Valid From]), 0),
            s.[Salesperson Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) e.[Employee Key]
                                            FROM Dimension.Employee AS e
                                            WHERE e.[WWI Employee ID] = s.[WWI Salesperson ID]
                                            AND s.[Last Modified When] > e.[Valid From]
                                            AND s.[Last Modified When] <= e.[Valid To]
									        ORDER BY e.[Valid From]), 0)
    FROM Integration.Sale_Staging AS s;

    -- Remove any existing entries for any of these invoices

    DELETE s
    FROM Fact.Sale AS s
    WHERE s.[WWI Invoice ID] IN (SELECT [WWI Invoice ID] FROM Integration.Sale_Staging);

    -- Insert all current details for these invoices

    INSERT Fact.Sale
        ([City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], [Invoice Date Key], [Delivery Date Key],
         [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description], Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate],
         [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items], [Lineage Key])
    SELECT [City Key], [Customer Key], [Bill To Customer Key], [Stock Item Key], [Invoice Date Key], [Delivery Date Key],
           [Salesperson Key], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description], Package, Quantity, [Unit Price], [Tax Rate],
           [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], Profit, [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items], @LineageKey
    FROM Integration.Sale_Staging;

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
        SET [Cutoff Time] = (SELECT [Source System Cutoff Time]
                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'Sale';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window


def run(spark, tables):
    lineage = tables["Integration.Lineage"]
    etl_cutoff = tables["Integration.ETL Cutoff"]
    city = tables["Dimension.City"]
    customer = tables["Dimension.Customer"]
    employee = tables["Dimension.Employee"]
    stock_item = tables["Dimension.Stock Item"]
    fact_sale = tables["Fact.Sale"]
    staging = tables["Integration.Sale_Staging"]

    staging_cols = staging.columns
    fact_cols = fact_sale.columns
    lineage_cols = lineage.columns
    cutoff_cols = etl_cutoff.columns

    # DECLARE @LineageKey = TOP(1) ... ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC
    lk_row = (
        lineage
        .filter((F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Sale")) & F.col("Data Load Completed").isNull())
        .orderBy(F.col("Lineage Key").desc_nulls_last())
        .select("Lineage Key")
        .limit(1)
        .collect()
    )
    lineage_key = lk_row[0]["Lineage Key"] if lk_row else None

    # UPDATE staging: dimension key lookups
    s = staging.withColumn("__rid", F.monotonically_increasing_id())

    def lookup(df, dim, dim_id_col, dim_key_col, stg_id_col, target_col):
        d = dim.select(
            F.col(dim_id_col).alias("__d_id"),
            F.col(dim_key_col).alias("__d_key"),
            F.col("Valid From").alias("__d_from"),
            F.col("Valid To").alias("__d_to"),
        )
        cond = (
            (F.col("__d_id") == F.col(stg_id_col))
            & (F.col("Last Modified When") > F.col("__d_from"))
            & (F.col("Last Modified When") <= F.col("__d_to"))
        )
        joined = df.join(d, cond, "left")
        w = Window.partitionBy("__rid").orderBy(
            F.col("__d_from").asc_nulls_first(), F.col("__d_key").asc_nulls_first()
        )
        joined = (
            joined.withColumn("__rn", F.row_number().over(w))
            .filter(F.col("__rn") == 1)
            .withColumn(
                target_col,
                F.coalesce(F.col("__d_key").cast("long"), F.lit(0).cast("long")),
            )
            .drop("__d_id", "__d_key", "__d_from", "__d_to", "__rn")
        )
        return joined

    s = lookup(s, city, "WWI City ID", "City Key", "WWI City ID", "City Key")
    s = lookup(s, customer, "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key", "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key")
    s = lookup(s, customer, "WWI Customer ID", "Customer Key", "WWI Bill To Customer ID", "Bill To Customer Key")
    s = lookup(s, stock_item, "WWI Stock Item ID", "Stock Item Key", "WWI Stock Item ID", "Stock Item Key")
    s = lookup(s, employee, "WWI Employee ID", "Employee Key", "WWI Salesperson ID", "Salesperson Key")

    s = s.localCheckpoint()

    new_staging = s.select(*[F.col(c) for c in staging_cols])

    # DELETE from Fact.Sale where invoice in staging
    stg_ids = (
        staging.select(F.col("WWI Invoice ID").alias("__inv"))
        .filter(F.col("__inv").isNotNull())
        .distinct()
    )
    kept = fact_sale.join(
        stg_ids, fact_sale["WWI Invoice ID"] == stg_ids["__inv"], "left_anti"
    )

    # INSERT new rows with identity Sale Key
    max_row = fact_sale.agg(F.max(F.col("Sale Key")).alias("m")).collect()
    max_key = max_row[0]["m"] if max_row and max_row[0]["m"] is not None else 0

    w_ins = Window.orderBy(F.col("Sale Staging Key").asc_nulls_first(), F.col("__rid"))
    ins = s.withColumn("__rn", F.row_number().over(w_ins))

    fact_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in fact_sale.schema.fields)

    def fc(name, expr):
        return expr.cast(fact_types[name]).alias(name)

    insert_exprs = []
    for c in fact_cols:
        if c == "Sale Key":
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.lit(max_key) + F.col("__rn")))
        elif c == "Lineage Key":
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.lit(lineage_key)))
        else:
            insert_exprs.append(fc(c, F.col(c)))
    inserted = ins.select(*insert_exprs)

    new_fact = kept.select(*[F.col(c) for c in fact_cols]).unionByName(inserted)

    # UPDATE Integration.Lineage
    lin_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in lineage.schema.fields)
    if lineage_key is not None:
        is_target = F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key)
    else:
        is_target = F.lit(False)
    is_target = F.coalesce(is_target, F.lit(False))

    lin_exprs = []
    for c in lineage_cols:
        if c == "Data Load Completed":
            lin_exprs.append(
                F.when(is_target, F.current_timestamp().cast(lin_types[c]))
                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        elif c == "Was Successful":
            lin_exprs.append(
                F.when(is_target, F.lit(True).cast(lin_types[c]))
                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        else:
            lin_exprs.append(F.col(c))
    new_lineage = lineage.select(*lin_exprs)

    # UPDATE Integration.ETL Cutoff
    cutoff_val = None
    if lineage_key is not None:
        rows = (
            lineage.filter(F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key))
            .select("Source System Cutoff Time")
            .limit(1)
            .collect()
        )
        cutoff_val = rows[0]["Source System Cutoff Time"] if rows else None

    cut_types = dict((f.name, f.dataType) for f in etl_cutoff.schema.fields)
    is_sale = F.coalesce(F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Sale"), F.lit(False))
    cut_exprs = []
    for c in cutoff_cols:
        if c == "Cutoff Time":
            cut_exprs.append(
                F.when(is_sale, F.lit(cutoff_val).cast(cut_types[c]))
                .otherwise(F.col(c))
                .alias(c)
            )
        else:
            cut_exprs.append(F.col(c))
    new_cutoff = etl_cutoff.select(*cut_exprs)

    return {
        "Integration.Sale_Staging": new_staging,
        "Fact.Sale": new_fact,
        "Integration.Lineage": new_lineage,
        "Integration.ETL Cutoff": new_cutoff,
    }

CREATE PROCEDURE Integration.MigrateStagedCityData
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @EndOfTime datetime2(7) =  '99991231 23:59:59.9999999';

    BEGIN TRAN;

    DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'City'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    WITH RowsToCloseOff
    AS
    (
        SELECT c.[WWI City ID], MIN(c.[Valid From]) AS [Valid From]
        FROM Integration.City_Staging AS c
        GROUP BY c.[WWI City ID]
    )
    UPDATE c
        SET c.[Valid To] = rtco.[Valid From]
    FROM Dimension.City AS c
    INNER JOIN RowsToCloseOff AS rtco
    ON c.[WWI City ID] = rtco.[WWI City ID]
    WHERE c.[Valid To] = @EndOfTime;

    INSERT Dimension.City
        ([WWI City ID], City, [State Province], Country, Continent,
         [Sales Territory], Region, Subregion, [Location],
         [Latest Recorded Population], [Valid From], [Valid To],
         [Lineage Key])
    SELECT [WWI City ID], City, [State Province], Country, Continent,
           [Sales Territory], Region, Subregion, [Location],
           [Latest Recorded Population], [Valid From], [Valid To],
           @LineageKey
    FROM Integration.City_Staging;

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
        SET [Cutoff Time] = (SELECT [Source System Cutoff Time]
                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'City';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window


def run(spark, tables):
    city = tables["Dimension.City"]
    staging = tables["Integration.City_Staging"]
    cutoff = tables["Integration.ETL Cutoff"]
    lineage = tables["Integration.Lineage"]

    # @LineageKey
    lk_row = (
        lineage.filter((F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("City")) & F.col("Data Load Completed").isNull())
        .orderBy(F.col("Lineage Key").desc())
        .select("Lineage Key")
        .limit(1)
        .collect()
    )
    lineage_key = lk_row[0][0] if lk_row else None

    end_of_time = F.to_timestamp(F.lit("9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999"))

    # Close off current rows
    rtco = staging.groupBy("WWI City ID").agg(F.min("Valid From").alias("__rtco_vf"))
    c = city.join(rtco, on="WWI City ID", how="left")
    cond = F.col("__rtco_vf").isNotNull() & (F.col("Valid To") >= end_of_time)
    city_cols = city.columns
    updated = c.select(
        *[
            (F.when(cond, F.col("__rtco_vf")).otherwise(F.col("Valid To")).alias("Valid To"))
            if col == "Valid To"
            else F.col(col)
            for col in city_cols
        ]
    )

    # Insert new rows with generated keys
    max_key_row = city.agg(F.max("City Key")).collect()
    max_key = max_key_row[0][0] if max_key_row and max_key_row[0][0] is not None else 0
    w = Window.orderBy(F.col("City Staging Key"))
    lk_lit = F.lit(lineage_key).cast(city.schema["Lineage Key"].dataType)
    new_rows = staging.withColumn("__rn", F.row_number().over(w)).select(
        *[
            (
                (F.lit(max_key) + F.col("__rn")).cast(city.schema["City Key"].dataType).alias("City Key")
                if col == "City Key"
                else lk_lit.alias("Lineage Key")
                if col == "Lineage Key"
                else F.col(col).cast(city.schema[col].dataType).alias(col)
            )
            for col in city_cols
        ]
    )
    new_city = updated.unionByName(new_rows)

    # Update lineage
    now = F.current_timestamp()
    if lineage_key is not None:
        is_lk = F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key)
        new_lineage = lineage.select(
            *[
                (F.when(is_lk, now).otherwise(F.col(col)).cast(lineage.schema[col].dataType).alias(col))
                if col == "Data Load Completed"
                else (F.when(is_lk, F.lit(True)).otherwise(F.col(col)).cast("boolean").alias(col))
                if col == "Was Successful"
                else F.col(col)
                for col in lineage.columns
            ]
        )
        sc_row = (
            lineage.filter(F.col("Lineage Key") == F.lit(lineage_key))
            .select("Source System Cutoff Time")
            .collect()
        )
        source_cutoff = sc_row[0][0] if sc_row else None
    else:
        new_lineage = lineage
        source_cutoff = None

    # Update ETL Cutoff
    cut_type = cutoff.schema["Cutoff Time"].dataType
    new_cutoff = cutoff.select(
        *[
            (
                F.when(F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("City"), F.lit(source_cutoff).cast("timestamp"))
                .otherwise(F.col(col))
                .cast(cut_type if str(cut_type) != "NullType()" else "timestamp")
                .alias(col)
            )
            if col == "Cutoff Time"
            else F.col(col)
            for col in cutoff.columns
        ]
    )

    return {
        "Dimension.City": new_city,
        "Integration.Lineage": new_lineage,
        "Integration.ETL Cutoff": new_cutoff,
    }

jobs.summary: Looks up four dimension keys, then MERGEs stock movements into Fact.Movement: update the ones that exist, insert the rest.

CREATE PROCEDURE Integration.MigrateStagedMovementData
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRAN;

    DECLARE @LineageKey int = (SELECT TOP(1) [Lineage Key]
                               FROM Integration.Lineage
                               WHERE [Table Name] = N'Movement'
                               AND [Data Load Completed] IS NULL
                               ORDER BY [Lineage Key] DESC);

    -- Find the dimension keys required

    UPDATE m
        SET m.[Stock Item Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) si.[Stock Item Key]
                                           FROM Dimension.[Stock Item] AS si
                                           WHERE si.[WWI Stock Item ID] = m.[WWI Stock Item ID]
                                           AND m.[Last Modifed When] > si.[Valid From]
                                           AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= si.[Valid To]
									       ORDER BY si.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Customer Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) c.[Customer Key]
                                         FROM Dimension.Customer AS c
                                         WHERE c.[WWI Customer ID] = m.[WWI Customer ID]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] > c.[Valid From]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= c.[Valid To]
									     ORDER BY c.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Supplier Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) s.[Supplier Key]
                                         FROM Dimension.Supplier AS s
                                         WHERE s.[WWI Supplier ID] = m.[WWI Supplier ID]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] > s.[Valid From]
                                         AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= s.[Valid To]
									     ORDER BY s.[Valid From]), 0),
            m.[Transaction Type Key] = COALESCE((SELECT TOP(1) tt.[Transaction Type Key]
                                                 FROM Dimension.[Transaction Type] AS tt
                                                 WHERE tt.[WWI Transaction Type ID] = m.[WWI Transaction Type ID]
                                                 AND m.[Last Modifed When] > tt.[Valid From]
                                                 AND m.[Last Modifed When] <= tt.[Valid To]
									             ORDER BY tt.[Valid From]), 0)
    FROM Integration.Movement_Staging AS m;

    -- Merge the data into the fact table

    MERGE Fact.Movement AS m
    USING Integration.Movement_Staging AS ms
    ON m.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID] = ms.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET m.[Date Key] = ms.[Date Key],
                   m.[Stock Item Key] = ms.[Stock Item Key],
                   m.[Customer Key] = ms.[Customer Key],
                   m.[Supplier Key] = ms.[Supplier Key],
                   m.[Transaction Type Key] = ms.[Transaction Type Key],
                   m.[WWI Invoice ID] = ms.[WWI Invoice ID],
                   m.[WWI Purchase Order ID] = ms.[WWI Purchase Order ID],
                   m.Quantity = ms.Quantity,
                   m.[Lineage Key] = @LineageKey
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT ([Date Key], [Stock Item Key], [Customer Key], [Supplier Key], [Transaction Type Key],
                [WWI Stock Item Transaction ID], [WWI Invoice ID], [WWI Purchase Order ID], Quantity, [Lineage Key])
        VALUES (ms.[Date Key], ms.[Stock Item Key], ms.[Customer Key], ms.[Supplier Key], ms.[Transaction Type Key],
                ms.[WWI Stock Item Transaction ID], ms.[WWI Invoice ID], ms.[WWI Purchase Order ID], ms.Quantity, @LineageKey);

    UPDATE Integration.Lineage
        SET [Data Load Completed] = SYSDATETIME(),
            [Was Successful] = 1
    WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey;

    UPDATE Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
        SET [Cutoff Time] = (SELECT [Source System Cutoff Time]
                             FROM Integration.Lineage
                             WHERE [Lineage Key] = @LineageKey)
    FROM Integration.[ETL Cutoff]
    WHERE [Table Name] = N'Movement';

    COMMIT;

    RETURN 0;
END;

def run(spark, tables):
    lineage = tables["Integration.Lineage"]
    cutoff = tables["Integration.ETL Cutoff"]
    staging = tables["Integration.Movement_Staging"]
    fact = tables["Fact.Movement"]

    staging_cols = staging.columns
    fact_cols = fact.columns
    lineage_cols = lineage.columns
    cutoff_cols = cutoff.columns

    # @LineageKey
    lk_row = (lineage
              .filter((F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Movement")) & F.col("Data Load Completed").isNull())
              .agg(F.max(F.col("Lineage Key")).alias("lk"))
              .collect())
    lineage_key = lk_row[0]["lk"] if lk_row else None

    # ---- Update staging dimension keys ----
    m = staging.withColumn("_rid", F.monotonically_increasing_id())

    def lookup(m, dim, dim_id_col, m_id_col, key_col, target_col):
        d = dim.select(
            F.col(dim_id_col).alias("_did"),
            F.col("Valid From").alias("_vf"),
            F.col("Valid To").alias("_vt"),
            F.col(key_col).alias("_k"),
        )
        mm = m.select(
            "_rid",
            F.col(m_id_col).alias("_mid"),
            F.col("Last Modifed When").alias("_lmw"),
        )
        j = mm.join(
            d,
            (F.col("_did") == F.col("_mid"))
            & (F.col("_lmw") > F.col("_vf"))
            & (F.col("_lmw") <= F.col("_vt")),
            "inner",
        )
        w = Window.partitionBy("_rid").orderBy(F.col("_vf").asc(), F.col("_k").asc())
        r = (j.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w))
               .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1)
               .select("_rid", F.col("_k").alias("_newkey")))
        m = (m.join(r, "_rid", "left")
               .withColumn(target_col, F.coalesce(F.col("_newkey"), F.lit(0)).cast("long"))
               .drop("_newkey"))
        return m

    m = lookup(m, tables["Dimension.Stock Item"], "WWI Stock Item ID", "WWI Stock Item ID",
               "Stock Item Key", "Stock Item Key")
    m = lookup(m, tables["Dimension.Customer"], "WWI Customer ID", "WWI Customer ID",
               "Customer Key", "Customer Key")
    m = lookup(m, tables["Dimension.Supplier"], "WWI Supplier ID", "WWI Supplier ID",
               "Supplier Key", "Supplier Key")
    m = lookup(m, tables["Dimension.Transaction Type"], "WWI Transaction Type ID", "WWI Transaction Type ID",
               "Transaction Type Key", "Transaction Type Key")

    new_staging = m.select(*[F.col(c) for c in staging_cols])

    # ---- MERGE into Fact.Movement ----
    lk_lit = F.lit(lineage_key).cast("long")
    upd_cols = ["Date Key", "Stock Item Key", "Customer Key", "Supplier Key",
                "Transaction Type Key", "WWI Invoice ID", "WWI Purchase Order ID", "Quantity"]

    s = new_staging.select(
        F.col("WWI Stock Item Transaction ID").alias("_s_tid"),
        *[F.col(c).alias("_s_" + c) for c in upd_cols],
        F.lit(1).alias("_matched"),
    )

    t = fact.join(s, fact["WWI Stock Item Transaction ID"] == s["_s_tid"], "left")
    matched = F.col("_matched").isNotNull()
    sel = []
    for c in fact_cols:
        if c in upd_cols:
            sel.append(F.when(matched, F.col("_s_" + c)).otherwise(F.col(c)).cast(fact.schema[c].dataType).alias(c))
        elif c == "Lineage Key":
            sel.append(F.when(matched, lk_lit).otherwise(F.col(c)).cast("long").alias(c))
        else:
            sel.append(F.col(c))
    updated_fact = t.select(*sel)

    fact_ids = fact.select(F.col("WWI Stock Item Transaction ID").alias("_f_tid"))
    to_insert = new_staging.join(
        fact_ids,
        new_staging["WWI Stock Item Transaction ID"] == fact_ids["_f_tid"],
        "left_anti",
    )

    max_key_row = fact.agg(F.max(F.col("Movement Key")).alias("mk")).collect()
    max_key = max_key_row[0]["mk"] if max_key_row and max_key_row[0]["mk"] is not None else 0

    w_ins = Window.orderBy(F.col("Movement Staging Key").asc(), F.col("WWI Stock Item Transaction ID").asc())
    inserted = to_insert.withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w_ins))
    ins_sel = []
    for c in fact_cols:
        dt = fact.schema[c].dataType
        if c == "Movement Key":
            ins_sel.append((F.lit(max_key) + F.col("_rn")).cast(dt).alias(c))
        elif c == "Lineage Key":
            ins_sel.append(lk_lit.cast(dt).alias(c))
        else:
            ins_sel.append(F.col(c).cast(dt).alias(c))
    inserted = inserted.select(*ins_sel)

    new_fact = updated_fact.unionByName(inserted)

    # ---- Update Lineage ----
    is_lk = (F.col("Lineage Key") == lk_lit) if lineage_key is not None else F.lit(False)
    lsel = []
    for c in lineage_cols:
        if c == "Data Load Completed":
            lsel.append(F.when(is_lk, F.current_timestamp().cast("timestamp")).otherwise(F.col(c)).alias(c))
        elif c == "Was Successful":
            lsel.append(F.when(is_lk, F.lit(True)).otherwise(F.col(c)).cast("boolean").alias(c))
        else:
            lsel.append(F.col(c))
    new_lineage = lineage.select(*lsel)

    # ---- Update ETL Cutoff ----
    cutoff_val = None
    if lineage_key is not None:
        rows = (lineage.filter(F.col("Lineage Key") == lk_lit)
                       .select("Source System Cutoff Time").limit(1).collect())
        if rows:
            cutoff_val = rows[0][0]
    csel = []
    for c in cutoff_cols:
        if c == "Cutoff Time":
            csel.append(
                F.when(F.col("Table Name") == F.lit("Movement"), F.lit(cutoff_val).cast("timestamp"))
                 .otherwise(F.col(c)).alias(c)
            )
        else:
            csel.append(F.col(c))
    new_cutoff = cutoff.select(*csel)

    return {
        "Integration.Movement_Staging": new_staging,
        "Fact.Movement": new_fact,
        "Integration.Lineage": new_lineage,
        "Integration.ETL Cutoff": new_cutoff,
    }
attempts.note: The MERGE itself is right: all 5,053 updated movement rows match. The failure is one realistic mistake. The code casts timestamps with .cast("timestamp"), which in Spark means a moment in time with a time zone. SQL Server's datetime2 has no time zone (Spark calls that timestamp_ntz). The values are the same moment, but the column changed type: 2016-06-06 12:31:17 came back as 2016-06-06 12:31:17+00:00. A downstream report would now apply time zone rules to it, so it counts as a real failure. The Sale translation avoided it by casting to the input column's own type.

dev.stability_probe: Staged once, ran the legacy job twice in separate rolled-back transactions, compared every column of every table (2026-11-04 21:21:22). Only columns that differed between those two runs may be ignored.

checker_tests.what: Planted bugs in jobs_pyspark/sale.py, each run through run_spark.py and check.py

bugs.name: real_translation
bugs.description: the real AI translation, no planted bug
bugs.why: Control. Must pass both, or the checker cries wolf.

bugs.name: changed_rows_only
bugs.description: Fact.Sale returns only the inserted rows, not the whole table
bugs.why: Fact.Sale shrinks from 228,265 rows to the few thousand reloaded ones.

bugs.name: default_decimal
bugs.description: Money columns cast with Spark's default decimal(10,0), losing the cents
bugs.why: 39,717 sale lines have cents in the unit price; decimal(10,0) rounds them away.

bugs.name: forget_cutoff
bugs.description: The Integration.[ETL Cutoff] update is left out
bugs.why: On dev the job sets the cutoff to the value it already had, so skipping the update looks perfect. The holdout window moves the cutoff.

bugs.name: ge_valid_from
bugs.description: Dimension lookups use >= instead of > on [Valid From]
bugs.why: No sale is stamped exactly at a version start, so >= and > always agree on this data (0 such lines in every month). Would catch it: a small boundary dataset with a sale at exactly a Valid From.

bugs.name: no_delete
bugs.description: Old lines of reloaded invoices are not deleted before the new ones are inserted
bugs.why: Reloaded invoices appear twice: old lines plus new ones.

bugs.name: no_valid_to
bugs.description: Dimension lookups forget the [Valid To] condition
bugs.why: Picks a customer's or product's oldest version instead of the one valid at sale time.

bugs.name: null_not_zero
bugs.description: No matching dimension row gives NULL instead of 0 (COALESCE dropped)
bugs.why: Thousands of lookups find no dimension row in every window, so NULLs show up straight away.

bugs.name: tax_rate_scale
bugs.description: Tax Rate written as decimal(18,2) instead of decimal(18,3)
bugs.why: Every tax rate is 15.000 or 10.000, and Python compares 15.000 == 15.00 as equal, so values match. Would catch it: comparing column types between after/ and spark/.

bugs.name: top1_desc
bugs.description: TOP(1) ... ORDER BY [Valid From] taken in the wrong order (newest first)
bugs.why: 776 dev lookups match two City versions, but in every case both have the same Valid From (a tie), and real version histories never overlap otherwise. So reversing the date order can never change a result here. Would catch it: only a dimension with overlapping date ranges, which is broken data.
